LanguageData.WBE_CaravanRaidChance: Strike team chance per enemy caravan: {0}
LanguageData.WBE_CaravanRaidChance_Desc: While your colony is neutral with XCC, each trade caravan from a faction hostile to XCC has this chance of drawing an XCC strike team. 0% turns it off.
LanguageData.WBE_AidPlunder: Unharmed XCC squads plunder when leaving
LanguageData.WBE_AidPlunder_Desc: An XCC squad called in with favor that leaves without taking any damage grabs valuables near it on the way out.
LanguageData.WBE_CaravanRaidLetterText: An {XCC_name} strike team has followed the {CARAVAN_name} caravan onto your land.\n\nXCC treats a neutral colony as its own turf. They are not here for you, but they will help themselves before they leave.
LanguageData.WBE_CaravanRaidPlunder: The {FACTION_name} strike team is helping itself to valuables before leaving.
LanguageData.WBE_AidPlunderMessage: The {FACTION_name} squad feels you wasted its time and is helping itself to valuables before leaving.
